front:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original sixteen-piece skeletal game character atlas.
Primary request: Upgrade the Ashen Raider man in reference1 into finely sculpted modern original game artwork and sixteen isolated body components for continuous animation. Reference1 establishes the EXACT identity and clothing; reference2 is only the modular parts layout/quality, never its female anatomy or clothes.
Subject: broad powerful adult male raider, olive tan skin, rugged heavy brow, thick dark beard, long dark hair tied in a practical high tail. Broad charcoal black layered fur shoulder mantle, crossed scuffed brown leather chest harness with two dark iron circular clasps, sleeveless leather cuirass, dark leather bracers, rust-red waist sash and practical plated leather hip strips over fitted dark trousers; fur-trimmed brown boots. Preserve recognizable silhouette, dark-fur shoulders, red sash and right-handed axe identity but NO AXE baked into these body components. Mature believable anatomy, muscular but natural, premium high-end 3D game art with fine tactile fur, cloth and leather. Cohesive original fantasy materials, no outlines/pixel art, no gold wash.
View: FRONT camera elevated25degrees, orthographic. All body surfaces in this view, natural neutral arm rotation. Both hands softly curled around an invisible handle, not open spread fingers. Left and right mean character's anatomical side.
Layout: EXACTLY4 columns×4rows;16 separate complete parts centered in regular cells with generous transparent margins. Every limb points straight DOWN proximal root to distal end, rounded joint-overlap caps, no blood. Do not assemble a person.
Row1 col1 head+neck, face and beard but NO long ponytail; col2 torso/shoulder fur mantle from shoulders to waist, NO arms/head; col3 belt/red-sash/leather-strip hip garment only, NO legs; col4 isolated long dark ponytail hanging down.
Row2 col1 LEFT upper arm muscular shoulder-to-elbow without forearm; col2 RIGHT upper arm shoulder-to-elbow; col3 LEFT bracer forearm elbow-to-wrist without hand; col4 RIGHT bracer forearm elbow-to-wrist without hand.
Row3 col1 LEFT relaxed closed gripping hand+wrist only; col2 RIGHT closed gripping hand+wrist only; col3 exactly ONE LEFT trouser THIGH hip-to-knee only; col4 exactly ONE RIGHT trouser THIGH hip-to-knee only. Never shorts or two legs in one cell.
Row4 col1 LEFT trouser shin knee-to-ankle; col2 RIGHT trouser shin knee-to-ankle; col3 LEFT front-view leather boot toes toward camera; col4 RIGHT front-view leather boot toes toward camera.
Keep each piece isolated with no tools/axe/weapons/shield/cargo. Soft warm upper-left key/coolambient bounce. No floor, scenery, shadows outsidepieces, text, labels, visiblegrid, checkerboard orbackgroundcolor. Genuine transparent PNG RGBA alpha0betweenparts.

transparentExtraction:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent PNG game sprite sheet
Primary request: Extract all separate character components from the supplied image onto a genuinely transparent background with an alpha channel.
Input image: edit target.
Constraints: keep every component and its placement, detail, color, facing direction and size unchanged. Remove only the painted checkerboard background. Preserve clean edges and all gaps. The output is a transparent cutout PNG, not an illustration of cutouts on paper.
